title: Group routes
summary: Fiber: Group routes. Add a /pets route to the group.
introduction: Group adds a shared path prefix. Open GET /api/books. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Add a /pets route to the group

blocks.text: Run go mod init school and go get github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2@v2.52.5 in a practice folder. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Group routes
blocks.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
api := app.Group("/api")
api.Get("/books", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.JSON([]string{"Moon Trip"}) })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

blocks.text: The group combines /api with /books for its final route.
Add a /pets route to the group.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Request the group prefix as well as the inner path.
